scope: Current Gothic crossing with Roman abutments and gateway, including the2026 crown protection; original exterior reconstruction.

primaryReferences.findings: Clear spans16.4m and36.4m; unequal bridge widths, Roman ashlar, central pier and minor east opening.2015images1/2 inspected; old gateway safety net is superseded by2026 restoration.
Eastern gateway location;9×10.6m base. Surviving rubble core, molded ashlar bases and one opening; missing ancient capitals are not restored conjecturally.
2007 excavation report section locates the unequal arches, pier, elevated east opening, east abutment and gateway. Vertical profile reconstructed proportionally; not a current survey.

Petrographic study distinguishes red/white sandstone, calcarenite and limestone. Figure3 overlays a hypothetical Roman bridge; the three hypothetical round spans are excluded. Narrative43m main span differs from36.4m clear span in the inventory; the model uses the latter.
Restored gateway opened22February2026. Redstone/lime repairs, consolidated calcarenite voussoirs, copper-sheet crown cap, paving and metalrail repairs. Photos inspected without downloading.
